purpose: Read-only Google Cloud access for the CyberGuard connector. Grant these predefined roles to the collector principal at the organization or folder scope. Every role below is a viewer or reviewer role; none can change resources, IAM policies, logs or findings.

roles.why: projects, enabled services, subnetworks (flow log state), firewall rules and Cloud Armor security policies
get-iam-policy on projects, folders and the organization
Security Command Center findings at the organization level
Cloud Audit Logs (Admin Activity), VPC Flow Logs, Firewall Rules Logging and load balancer logs with Cloud Armor; Data Access logs additionally need roles/logging.privateLogViewer
Cloud Asset Inventory searches across projects
